_note: ALL VALUES ARE NOMINAL ASSUMPTIONS — calibrate with real suit data before trusting them. Exception: the radiation block is a published measurement.
_budget_note: Metabolic energy for one 8 h EVA at 1200 BTU/h (351.7 W): the Apollo PLSS design average and NASA's expected sizing rate for future EVAs in planetary gravity (Waligora et al., NASA TN D-7883; NASA ICES 2026, NTRS 20260005410). The ISS EMU basis (1000 BTU/h) would give 8.44 MJ, and then the default route fails. Only walking energy (Pandolf) is charged: station work and rest are not modelled, so the margin shown is an upper bound. return_margin 0.2 follows Apollo walkback practice (1440 = 1.2 x 1200 BTU/h).

radiation.event_site: Gale crater (Curiosity RAD); not measured at Jezero
radiation._note: A quiet-day baseline (210 µGy/day, Hassler et al. 2014) was dropped: its source (the NTRS abstract) does not state it.
